program.title: An essential part of the game
program.body:
Referees are critical to Prospector Soccer Club’s success. Our program builds a qualified, well-trained group of referees held to high standards. We actively recruit, develop and advance referees at all levels.

Referees should know and correctly apply the Laws of the Game.
